newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT buys two Bunzl units.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT buys two Bunzl units.

text.p: Dutch paper and office equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Tuesday it had reached agreement on taking over two paper wholesalers from Britain's Bunzl Plc .
The units concerned are Wilhelm Seiler GmbH in Wuppertal, Germany, and Milan-based Bunzl Italia SpA.
Seiler has 14 outlets in Germany and Bunzl Italia has 11 centres in Italy. The two firms expect combined 1996 turnover of more than 550 million guilders ($315.3 million) and employ 500 people.

In a separate statement issued in London, Bunzl said it had sold the units for about 61.6 million stg, 57.6 million of which would be payable in cash. Another four million stg consisted of loans which would be assumed by KNP BT, Bunzl said.

KNP BT said Seiler and Bunzl Italia would complement the activities of its own German and Italian paper wholesalers Hartmann & Flinsch and CCC. The takeover fitted the strategy of investing in core activities, KNP BT said.
